verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for llms.txt at rocm.docs.amd.com. That is the ROCm documentation site covering Radeon GPUs such as the RX 9070 XT (gfx1201), and the file notes that each docs project has its own llms.txt, so an agent can be pointed at machine-readable docs for this card's AI software stack. Missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt content depth or coverage of the Radeon-specific project, agent-oriented docs for the consumer product pages and AMD Software, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents use these files effectively.
